newsitem.title: USA: NAPM-N.Y. business conditions index 64.9 in June.
newsitem.headline: NAPM-N.Y. business conditions index 64.9 in June.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions soared to 64.9 in June from 50.8 in May.
Manufacturing-sector conditions rose to 74.4 from 64.1 in May, the report said.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index also jumped to 63.8 in June from 49.3 the month before.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimism improved further in June, NAPM said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 67.1 in June compared to 64.9 in May, the report said.
